name: gp075_rubric_for_unknowns
description: Can ZTARE generate structurally valid rubrics for domains where no GT exists? Rubric-as-method vs rubric-as-key. Which criteria are GT-independent? Where does Goodhart bite when the rubric itself is the optimization target? Connects to INS-012 (rubric-as-eval gaming) and the calibration-to-discovery transition.
